Starts the workflow at a fixed interval, or at times of day in a time zone.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | `trigger.schedule` |
| Kind | Trigger: starts executions |
| Outputs | `main` |

## Settings

| Setting | Kind | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Runs (`mode`) | text | no | `every` | every: at a fixed interval. at: at times of day, on the days ticked, in a time zone. One of `every`, `at`. |
| Every (`interval`) | duration, e.g. `30s`, `5m`, `1h` | no |  | With every: a duration like 30s or 5m. |
| Run on start (`runOnStart`) | true or false | no | `true` | With every: also fire as soon as the workflow is switched on. |
| At (`times`) | list of text | no |  | With at: times of day, 24-hour, one per line, e.g. 06:30. |
| On (`days`) | list of text | no |  | With at: the days it runs; none ticked, every day. One of `mon`, `tue`, `wed`, `thu`, `fri`, `sat`, `sun`. |
| Time zone (`zone`) | text | no | `UTC` | With at: whose clock the times are, as the IANA database names it, e.g. America/Chicago or Europe/London. Daylight saving is followed. |
| City's time zone (`city`) | text | no |  | With at: a city Polymarket lists temperature markets for, whose time zone it takes in place of Time zone. One of `Amsterdam`, `Ankara`, `Atlanta`, `Austin`, `Beijing`, `Buenos Aires`, `Busan`, `Cape Town`, `Chengdu`, `Chicago`, `Chongqing`, `Dallas`, `Denver`, `Guangzhou`, `Helsinki`, `Hong Kong`, `Houston`, `Istanbul`, `Jeddah`, `Jinan`, `Karachi`, `Kuala Lumpur`, `London`, `Los Angeles`, `Lucknow`, `Madrid`, `Manila`, `Mexico City`, `Miami`, `Milan`, `Moscow`, `Munich`, `NYC`, `Panama City`, `Paris`, `Qingdao`, `San Francisco`, `Sao Paulo`, `Seattle`, `Seoul (Incheon)`, `Shanghai`, `Shenzhen`, `Singapore`, `Taipei`, `Tel Aviv`, `Tokyo`, `Toronto`, `Warsaw`, `Wellington`, `Wuhan`, `Zhengzhou`. |
| Make up a missed run (`catchUp`) | true or false | no | `false` | When Polythought was down as a run fell due, run once as it starts again, for the latest time missed; its item says missed: true. With every, only when Run on start is off. |
| Make up within (`catchUpWithin`) | duration, e.g. `30s`, `5m`, `1h` | no | `1h` | How long after its time a missed run is still made up. |

## Items

Each item has these fields. Decimals are text, so they stay exact; times are RFC 3339 text.

| Field | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `firedAt` | time | When the schedule fired. |
| `due` | time | When the run was due: the time of day it is for, or the tick. |
| `missed` | true or false | A run made up, missed while Polythought was down. |
